title: Risex Documentaries
author: Risex Documentaries
description:
🎙️ TRUE CRIME & MYSTERIES

Real cases. Hidden details. Unanswered questions.

Explore fascinating true crime stories, mysterious disappearances, unsolved cases, investigations, and events that continue to raise questions.

Each episode takes you through the timeline, evidence, theories, and unexpected details behind cases that captured public attention.

🔎 Some cases have answers. Others remain mysteries.

Follow the podcast and discover the stories behind the headlines — one case at a time.

title: Honest To God Podcast
author: Zoe Willis
description: A Hollywood makeup artist and an English homeschooling mum of six walk into a podcast…  Felicia Linsky and Zoë Willis live in very different worlds. They have big opinions, very little interest in polite small talk, and an alarming willingness to discuss the things everyone else is thinking but perhaps knows better than to say out loud.  From motherhood, marriage and menopause to ageing, beauty, family, faith, culture, the-youth-of-today and whatever on earth has annoyed them this week, Honest to God is two friends comparing notes on life from opposite sides of the Atlantic...and occasionally opposite sides of an argument.  Expect honest conversation, unexpected rabbit holes, disagreements, inappropriate laughter and probably some swearing. Nobody is pretending to have all the answers.  Just the sort of conversations that usually happen when everyone sensible has left the room.  Honest to God. Because apparently nothing is sacred.

description: "Welcome to Death Care Today—the show where we bring light, clarity, and compassion to the topics we rarely talk about, but all eventually face.

title: The View From Here with Jared Sinclair
author: Jared Sinclair
description:
The View From Here with Jared Sinclair brings you face to face with fascinating, intelligent, and successful people. Founders, leaders, experts, and thinkers who've climbed high enough, researched deep enough, and experienced enough to see and understand things the rest of us might miss. We sit down for real, unscripted conversations about how they think, what they've learned, and the hard won perspective behind their knowledge and success. Every episode hands you a front row seat to perspective, ideas, and knowledge you won't find anywhere else, the kind of insight that shifts how you think, sharpens how you make decisions, and gives you an edge most people never get. 
No filters, no fluff, just candid conversations with people worth listening to.

title: InFocus Podcast - Phylip Morgan
author: Focus Technology Europe Ltd
description:
We're excited to launch the very first episode of InFocus, the new podcast from Focus Technology Europe, where we explore the topics shaping the future of business, technology and innovation.

For our debut episode, Focus Technology Europe CEO Andrew Davenport sits down with Phylip Morgan of Pax8 for a thought-provoking discussion on the challenges and opportunities facing organisations in today's rapidly evolving technology landscape.

Together, they explore:

 ✅ The current business and economic landscape

 ✅ How organisations can use technology to drive growth and profitability

 ✅ The real opportunities and practical applications of AI

 ✅ The risks of Shadow AI and the importance of governance

 ✅ Balancing security, productivity and innovation

 ✅ What separates digitally successful businesses from those being left behind

 ✅ The technology trends that will define the next few years

Whether you're a business owner, senior leader, technology professional or simply curious about how AI and emerging technologies are transforming the world of work, this episode is packed with insights, practical advice and forward-looking perspectives.

This is just the beginning for InFocus, and we can't think of a better first guest than Phylip to help unpack what modern businesses need to know to stay competitive in an increasingly technology-driven world.

title: Emily Knight: Private Eye
author: evalyski
description:
Emily Knight is a young private investigator, quick and sharp and good at what she does. She takes cases for the right reasons, even when the people asking can't always pay.

Every episode is one self-contained case, about thirty minutes long. A ring goes missing at a charity gala. A simple favor turns out not to be simple. A room full of polite people each has something to hide. It's light on the jokes and serious about the puzzle, and the clues are in the story if you're listening closely. Start with any episode.

Every voice in this show is AI-generated, including Emily's. The story map behind each case is designed by a human.

title: PODCASTIUM - Crea un podcast
author: Gianluca Russello
description:
Un podcast che aiuta a creare un podcast a chiunque voglia raccontare una storia, parlare dei propri hobby o vendere i propri servizi. In questo progetto troverai informazioni, guide pratiche e consigli veramente utili per iniziare l'avventura nel mondo dei podcast e monetizzare la tua voce. Podcastium è anche una piattaforma, unica in Italia, dedicata al podcasting indipendente, con spazi di informazione e formazione, oltre a contenere la prima Intelligenza Artificiale dedicata al podcasting, costruita per accompagnarti passo passo nella creazione e lancio del tuo podcast.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Spark Podcast: Nashville
author: Creative Assembly
description:
The Spark Podcast amplifies Nashville's creative voices, showcasing diverse talents and fostering growth through shared journeys. By exploring the unique experiences and stories of the city's agency owners, innovators, and creators, the podcast inspires connection and collaboration, reflecting Nashville's rich creative culture. 
Listen to The Spark Podcast: Nashville on Spotify, Apple Podcasts and YouTube, or at creativeassembly.agency.

title: The A-List with Andrea Logan
author: Andrea Logan
description: The A-List with Andrea Logan is where faith meets ambition —unfiltered conversations about reinvention, wellness, relationships, entrepreneurship, Hollywood, and what it really takes to build an extraordinary life without losing yourself in the process. Hosted by actress, author, entrepreneur, producer and mom of three Andrea Logan, the show goes beyond the highlight reel with inspiring guests and honest stories about failure, comeback, purpose, identity, and discovering that God’s A-List often looks very different from the world’s.

title: The GYM session
author: Charlie Copsey &  Fleur East

Welcome to The GYM Session!


It’s Fleur East and Charlie Copsey here, founders of Grow Your Movement, the community platform for women to learn, connect and grow


Join us for weekly episodes where we bring you along the journey as we build our platform and community. 

This is where we have honest conversation about our experiences in real time. 

Our personal bests, our biggest challenges, our fears, failures and small wins, nothing is off limits. 


But that’s not all! 


We will also have weekly FLEX sessions. Providing weekly bitesize episodes with our PTs (experts) across finance, fitness, health, mindset and communication and career. These will provide you with expert knowledge and practical tips that you can put into action straight away.

From scaling private practices to managing multi-location organizations, each episode delivers clear, candid, and compelling conversations to help business owners, executives, and industry leaders build, optimize, and scale their behavioral health organizations—without losing sight of their mission.

title: Her Again Podcast
author: Julie Ha
description:
You’ve spent so much time being who everyone else needed that somewhere along the way, you stopped recognizing yourself. HER AGAIN is for the woman ready to break unhealthy patterns, rebuild her self-worth, and create deeper relationships without losing herself inside them. 
Hosted by relationship and mindset coach Julie Ha, each episode brings honest conversations, personal stories and practical tools to help you heal, trust yourself and become the woman you’re meant to be. You’re not starting over. You’re becoming HER AGAIN.

title: JesusHouse Podcast
author: JesusHouse
description:
JESUSHOUSE is a new church expression in Lancaster County PA, honoring the region’s legacy of faith and spirituality while stepping into what God is doing today.

Check here weekly for our sermon of the week.

title: The Doing Enough Podcast
author: Cesar Gamiz
description: The Doing Enough Podcast is hosted by Cesar. The podcast’s mission is to break through the systems and stigmas that prevent people from being their authentic selves by being audacious, identifying the root causes, and beginning to unlock their true potential through entertainment. While the podcast will cover self-reflection, it won’t stop there. Hot topics and current events in pop culture are always fun to talk about, but seeing them through an introspective lens will make it all worth listening to.

title: Be The Only
author: Subrat Sahoo
description:
BETHEONLY is a podcast about entrepreneurship, business, personal growth, innovation and the people building what’s next. title: The Zach Martin Show
author: NEWHD Media

Zach Martin brings the guests to the microphone: authors, entertainment figures, sports voices, movers and shakers, corporate leaders, and entrepreneurs. The conversation is direct. New episodes on IRHUB Radio. Listen on Spreaker and everywhere you get podcasts.

title: Dr. Roni and Glaze: Whole Body Health and Redemption
author: Dr Roni and The Real Brian Glaze Gibbs
description:
Two powerful journeys come together for honest conversations about health, healing, redemption and transformation.
Dr. Roni, a respected holistic health expert with more than 30 years of experience, joins Brian “Glaze” Gibbs, a man who survived the streets, accepted responsibility for his past and chose a different purpose. Together, they explore what it truly takes to change your health, your thinking and the direction of your life.
Through real stories, practical wellness education and unfiltered conversations, Dr. Roni & Glaze confront the choices, habits and conditions that can destroy.

title: Why the Internet Works
author: Robby D.E.I, Dr. C and a Forman
description: Discourse of the people that created the history of technology in the last 200 years, and how it will shape our next 200 years.  The globe is in the middle of largest transformation since the dark ages.  As we transition from Capitalism to Connectivism, we need to rethink how to create a sustainable future with lessons from the past.

title: The Fantasy Frenzy
author: Brad Lowe
description: The Fantasy Frenzy | A Fantasy Football Podcast  Welcome to The Fantasy Frenzy, where fantasy football meets bold predictions, blockbuster trades, and a little bit of chaos!  Join Ashley and Sergio (aka the Lock City Mayor) as they break down everything happening in the world of fantasy football. Famously Yourself is a podcast about the modern actor and performer, bringing conversations about everything that happens beyond the role.

title: The Secret Lives of Artists
author: The Museum of Modern Art
description: An abstract artist who ran for mayor of New York. A public garden gatekeeper who painted her visions at night. An avant-garde composer who appeared on a game show as a mushroom expert. The Museum of Modern Art brings you a podcast telling the stories you don’t know about the artists you think you do. Each episode explores the secret talents and obsessive pursuits of some of our favorite modern artists. Hosted by MoMA content producer Naeem Douglas and featuring special guests, the podcast blends narration, interviews, and archival audio.

title: Under the Influence
author: BehaviourLAB Consulting
description:
Welcome to Under the Influence - the podcast that cuts through the corporate Bullsh*t and dives deep into what actually works when it comes to leadership, culture, and people at work. 

Hosted by Sam Walsham and Laura Bache, Co-founders of BehaviourLab Consulting.  We've spent years helping organisations turn fluffy culture promises into real, evidence-based change. Under the influence explores how most of what's trending on LinkedIn... doesn't stand up to scrutiny. 

 

From "quiet quitting" and generational stereotypes, to leadership buzzwords and culture hacks - this podcast unpacks the fads, questions the hype, and gives you the behavioural science behind the headlines. 


Each episode will break down one hot topic - what people are saying, what the research really shows, and what you can actually do about it in your team, your business, or your own career. 

So if you're under the influence of the latest people and culture trends - this podcast is your hangover cure. 


More science, less nonsense!

Okay So, What’s Next? is a podcast about the moments that change everything, and the weird, exciting, uncertain part that comes after.
Hosted by actor Parker Jackson, each episode features honest conversations with actors, creators, founders, filmmakers, musicians, and people across entertainment and culture about ambition, identity, reinvention, risk, and what they’re actually building toward next.
Less about the polished success story. More about what happens next.

Hosted by Melissa Petersen, the show explores answered prayers, miracles, provision, healing, redemption, forgiveness, coming to faith, and moments when God moved in unexpected ways. We’ll also talk about loss, waiting, uncertainty, and seasons when God seemed absent. Through honest conversations, personal stories, and Scripture, we’ll ask: Where was God? title: The First Nations Brief
author: Studio West
description:
The national conversation about First Nations peoples has been reduced to documents, targets and annual reports. Strategies get launched. Policies get announced. Plans get signed off. But too little changes in the lives of First Nations peoples, and too few organisations stop to ask why.


The First Nations Brief exists to ask why.


It's about strategy. Cultural intelligence. Policy development. Evaluation. Social policy. Reconciliation. And the social and political realities First Nations peoples live with every day, which decide whether any of it works.


Hosted by Dixie Crawford, founder of Nganya, the show is for the people who design, fund, deliver and measure decisions affecting First Nations peoples. That includes policy makers and public servants, executives and boards, strategy and evaluation professionals, not-for-profit and community sector leaders, reconciliation leads, researchers, and First Nations professionals and leaders.


Every episode is a brief: one question, the real problem behind it, and the social and political context that usually gets left out. Dixie then shares her take, drawn from over two decades across government, corporate and community settings, and what leaders can do differently.

description:

description: Different People Change the World Podcast is a faith-based, inspirational podcast hosted by Jenson Day and a guest host. Drawing from his own experiences with cerebral palsy, Jenson explores what it means to be different and how God can use our differences for a greater purpose. Through encouraging interviews and uplifting discussions, this podcast reminds listeners that different people really do change the world.

description: How did gaming’s biggest names fall apart? How It Ended is a video game history podcast exploring the rise and fall of iconic franchises, consoles, and studios. From beloved classics to ambitious failures, discover what went wrong, what survived, and why these stories still matter. Follow for retro gaming nostalgia and the stories behind the endings.

Blending decades of mental health expertise with hard-won resilience, she unpacks trauma, toxic cultures, and reclaiming personal autonomy. If you are navigating environments that shrink you, recovering from upheaval, or learning to lay down the heavy armor of survival, you are not alone. Take a breath, stop hiding, and let’s talk about it.

description: A Greater Life in Later Life. That's what this podcast is about. The Later Life Podcast talks to the people and digs into the topics that help over-60s get the most out of the years ahead: health, money, learning, travel, family, and the passions that motivate us most. It's practical and warm but never patronising. Come for the advice and stay for the stories.

title: Everyday Tools & Creative Ideas
author: kalsoom UK
description: Everyday Tools & Creative Ideas explores simple digital tools, learning activities, classroom resources, games, and creative techniques that can make everyday tasks easier and more engaging. Each episode looks at practical ideas that people can use for teaching, brainstorming, word games, writing exercises, group activities, and personal projects. From small browser-based utilities to clever ways of turning simple ideas into useful activities, the show focuses on accessible solutions that do not require complicated setups. Whether you're a teacher looking for a quick classroom activity, a writer searching for inspiration, or simply someone who enjoys discovering useful online resources, this podcast offers practical ideas worth trying.

title: The Unchased Life
author: Jen Meade
description: If you’ve ever stared at your phone wondering why he hasn’t texted, stayed for his potential, or felt like you had to earn love—this podcast is for you. I spent years thinking I had a man problem. I didn’t. I had a pattern. In Episode 1, I’m sharing what The Unchased Life means and how the 5 R’s—Reveal, Rewire, Regulate, Rebuild & Rehearse—help you finally stop repeating the same relationship and start choosing yourself.

description: Beneath the Decks is a cinematic interview and live-performance series for dance music artists. Each episode pairs a personal, unscripted conversation that is filmed at a location the artist chooses that is significant to them in some way with a full live DJ set shot in the same spot, fully curated by the artist. No PR spin, no scripted questions. Just the story beneath the sound, and the music that comes from it.

author: Tracie Taylor
description: The Ardent Standard is for founders and business leaders who know something isn’t working, but the obvious problem may not be the real one. Hosted by Tracie Taylor, PMP, the show looks beyond the symptoms to uncover what’s really happening across your people, structure, systems, finances, and leadership. Expect practical, direct conversations that help you step out of the weeds, see your business more clearly, and focus on what actually needs to change.

title: The History of Funk Music Podcast
author: History Podcasts & Josh Linsk
description:
Explore the raw, rhythmic, and endlessly influential history of funk music. The History of Funk Music Podcast traces the singers, bands, bassists, producers, record labels, studios, cities, and cultural movements that transformed funk into one of the most important sounds in modern music.

Episodes journey from the gospel, soul, R&B, and jazz roots of funk through the groundbreaking work of James Brown, Sly and the Family Stone, Parliament-Funkadelic, The Meters, Ohio Players, Earth, Wind & Fire, and countless others. The show explores syncopated rhythms, bass-driven grooves, horn arrangements, studio experimentation, Afrofuturism, dance culture, fashion, live performance, regional scenes, record production, and the evolution of funk through the 1960s, 1970s, and beyond.

Whether you are fascinated by classic funk records, legendary bass lines, psychedelic funk, P-Funk, dance music, or the genre’s enormous influence on disco, hip-hop, R&B, rock, pop, and electronic music, the podcast tells the stories behind the artists, songs, scenes, and innovations that shaped the sound. The History of Funk Music Podcast is hosted by Josh Linsk.

In our podcast we will explore what it is like being a witch in today’s society. We will be discussing a multitude of subjects including spells that we have used, our thoughts, beliefs on witchcraft and local lore from our place of residency in Bucks County, Pennsylvania. Enjoy the banter of this your four hostesses. Sit a spell for some hints and casting spells in the art of witchcraft. Listen to spooky tales from the area. Email us at Wewitches4@gmail.com

We’re excited to introduce The Voice of Hope Podcast, a space for meaningful conversations about faith, community, life, and the places where we discover hope, even in difficult seasons.
Hosted by Nancy Schmidt, each conversation invites us to listen, reflect, learn from one another, and explore a simple but important questions: What does hope mean to you? Where do you find hope? What if hope is not something you have to go out and find? What if hope's already searching for you?

With this podcast, you won't just hear the ENTIRE Bible read aloud, Genesis to Revelation... you'll finally make Scripture a living part of your everyday life!

Listen and...
Hear the ENTIRE Bible read aloud, Genesis to Revelation

Every episode welcomes an expert to explain the medical and emotional nitty gritty of why things go wrong and what we can do about it. 88% of Australian mums face challenges breastfeeding – that is a crazy stat! The Boobing Podcast wants to normalise talking about and working through breastfeeding issues. If 88% of us are having trouble, we need real help, guidance, and sometimes a hug, laugh, or a shoulder to cry on!

title: The Whole Enchilada: Arnold Schwarzenegger  and the Making of California's Historic Global Warming Law
author: Arnold Schwarzenegger and Joe Mathews; Read by Edoardo Ballerini
description: Twenty years ago, California Gov. Arnold Schwarzengger signed into law, Assembly Bill 32, officially named the Global Warming Solutions Act of 2006., it was the first law in the world to establish legally-binding reductions in greenhouse gas emissions across an entire economy.. But the law almost never passed. Drawing on documents that have never before been made public, "The Whole Enchilada" tells the improbable story of the making of a law that inspired a generation of environmental action around the world—and should inspire us to renew our efforts today.

title: Golf cart chronicles
author: whoisyourhero
description:
🎙️ GOLF CART CHRONICLES

What’s said after the swing.

Golf Cart Chronicles is a podcast recorded in a golf cart — over a round of golf — where real conversations unfold once the swing is over and the masks come off.

There’s no studio.
No scripts.
No pressure to perform.

Just two people sharing a cart, a few laughs, a few truths, and whatever comes out between the shots.

Some conversations are light.
Some go deep.
Some wander where they’re meant to.

This podcast isn’t about golf scores or swing tips.
It’s about life, resilience, pressure, purpose, mistakes, lessons, and the things men don’t always plan to talk about — but do, when the timing’s right.

Sometimes it’s 9 holes.
Sometimes it’s 18.
The conversation decides.

Hosted by Buzz, creator of Who Is Your Hero, Golf Cart Chronicles is for anyone who knows that the most important moments in life don’t happen on the scorecard — they happen after the swing.

⛳🎙️ If you’re up for a round and a real yarn, you’re already qualified.

title: Call Your Mom
author: Call Your Mom

On **Call Your Mom**, 23 year old daughter Frances reads real letters from people looking for advice, and Ann—the mom—answers them. Maybe your relationship with your mom is complicated, maybe she's no longer around, or maybe the question is simply too awkward to ask her. Whatever the reason, you can ask us. Expect honest advice, a little tough love, and the kind of conversation that leaves you thinking, laughing, and maybe calling your mom. Are you looking for advice? Email: CallYourMomPod@outlook.com!

title: The Fragrance Trade: Inside Perfume Oils
author: alfie martin
description:
The Fragrance Trade is an informative podcast exploring the world of perfume oils, fragrance sourcing, product development, wholesale distribution, and the evolving fragrance industry. Each episode examines how perfume oils are selected, evaluated, blended, packaged, and introduced to different markets, while offering practical insights for fragrance retailers, entrepreneurs, resellers, and enthusiasts.The series aims to make the business and creative sides of fragrance easier to understand. Topics can include fragrance profiles, oil-based perfumes, wholesale purchasing considerations, supplier relationships, quality evaluation, inventory planning, branding, customer preferences, and the role of regional fragrance markets.

For businesses researching sourcing opportunities, understanding the wholesale landscape can be an important part of building a sustainable fragrance operation. Resources such as perfume oil wholesale dubai can provide a useful starting point for exploring the broader subject of wholesale perfume oils and fragrance supply.Rather than focusing solely on selling products, the podcast will explain the principles behind successful fragrance sourcing and help listeners make more informed decisions about products, suppliers, positioning, and market opportunities.Series Objectives
  • Explain the fundamentals of perfume oils and fragrance products.

title: The Constant Advocate Podcast · Holding Institutions Accountable
author: Constant Legal Group
description:
The Constant Advocate Podcast by Constant Legal Group


Powerful institutions, such as churches, corporations, schools, hotel chains, pharmaceutical companies, and government agencies, have spent decades perfecting the art of protecting themselves. They have legal teams, communications teams, and long institutional memories for what works when something goes wrong and needs to
disappear quietly.

The Constant Advocate exists because those institutions should not have the last word. Hosted by the attorneys and experts of Constant Legal Group, a national plaintiffs firm representing survivors of sexual abuse, human trafficking, and victims of dangerous drugs and defective medical devices, The Constant Advocate brings together the people who know this world most deeply – the legal experts who litigate against these institutions, the policy advocates who fight to change the laws that protected them for too long, the researchers and journalists who exposed what was being hidden, the psychologists who know how deeply the wounds of the trauma cut, and the survivors who lived it and chose to speak.

Every episode is a conversation about accountability. It’s a conversation about what it takes to hold a powerful institution responsible for the harm it caused. It’s about the legal tools that exist, and the ones that still need to be built. Ultimately, this podcast is about the human beings at the center of every abuse and negligence, and what justice
actually looks like when it finally arrives.

We talk about clergy abuse and the dioceses that covered it up. We talk about hotel chains and online platforms that profited from human trafficking. We talk about pharmaceutical corporations that concealed what they knew about dangerous drugs, and medical device manufacturers who rushed products to market without telling patients what could go wrong. We talk about the lookback window legislation that has given survivors a second chance at accountability, and the fights still ahead.

We believe that informed people change things. We know that survivors who understand their legal rights are harder to silence. We have seen that institutions which know they are being watched behave differently than institutions that operate in the dark. And we are convinced that every conversation that names what happened, clearly, publicly, with specificity (yet always protecting confidentiality), makes the next one a little easier.

We are The Constant Advocate. Because someone has to be.

New episodes available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, and wherever you listen.

Free consultations available, contact us at www.constantlg.com · 855-906-2561

I'm late diagnosed autistic and ADHD (AuDHD), queer, chronically ill, perimenopausal, polyamorous and kink-aware and I speak from both lived experience and professional training. Each episode explores the experiences that have shaped them: their upbringing, struggles and triumphs, moments of courage and resilience, and the people and places that have influenced who they have become.

Drawing on her own journey from science to art, Dr. Paul is especially interested in the connections between art, creativity, mental health, and well-being, while opening the conversation to the many different ways people find strength, purpose, belonging, and joy.

At its heart, Heart to Heart with Hyacinth is about listening to one another. It celebrates kindness, cultural heritage, perseverance, creativity, community, and the goodness that often goes unnoticed in everyday life.

A Harum-Scarum Schoolgirl by Angela Brazil.  
"A Harum-Scarum Schoolgirl" by Angela Brazil is a novel written in the early 20th century. The story centers around Diana Hewlitt, a spirited American girl who arrives at Pendlemere Abbey, a British boarding school, under somewhat unexpected circumstances. The book likely explores themes of friendship, adventure, and the challenges of adapting to a new environment, infused with humor and youthful exuberance. The opening of the novel introduces a group of schoolgirls grappling with the sudden departure of their beloved principal, Mrs. Gifford, and the arrival of the new headmistress, Miss Todd. As the girls express their disappointment and trepidation over the changes, Diana Hewlitt is introduced as the new girl who 'drops in' unexpectedly with a vibrant personality and a penchant for mischief. The girls quickly engage in banter about their new dynamics, and an interesting twist occurs when Diana impresses them with playful antics, showcasing her charm and ability to capture attention. The initial chapters set the stage for a rich exploration of school life and friendships, foreshadowing the adventures Diana will undoubtedly embark upon in her new setting.

title: Jilted Girl

description:
Dating is the laboratory. Identity is the mystery.

Jilted Girl began with a question I couldn't stop asking:

What actually happened?

Not what I hoped happened. Not what I feared happened. Not the story I constructed at two o'clock in the morning because someone didn't text me back. What actually happened?

So, I started looking at the evidence. I thought I was investigating dating. It turns out dating was only where the investigation began.

Jilted Girl is a first-person investigation into the stories we inherit, the stories we tell ourselves, and the strange ways they follow us into love, family, loss, identity, and the choices we make without ever quite knowing why.

There are case files here. Men and messages. Mixed signals and questionable decisions. But there are also childhood stories, old assumptions, unexpected patterns, and moments when the evidence points somewhere I absolutely did not expect.

This isn't a dating advice podcast. There are no gurus, no ten-step plans, and no pretending to have all the answers. We're going to look at what actually happened.

Facts before conclusions.
Curiosity before certainty.
Evidence before assumptions.

And if the evidence changes, so does the working theory.

Sometimes it's funny. Sometimes it's uncomfortable. Sometimes it gets surprisingly personal.
But that's the investigation.

Don't solve mysteries that time will solve for free.

Well... this should be interesting.

title: חשופה
author: niv cohen
description:
בואו נדבר על מה שבאמת קורה בינינו.
על אהבה. על תשוקה. על משיכה. על גברים. על נשים. על סקס. על פרידות. על בגידות. על הלב שנשבר, על האגו שנפגע, על ההודעות שאנחנו מנתחות עם חברות ועל כל הפעמים שאנחנו יודעות שמישהו לא נכון לנו — ועדיין לא מצליחות לשחרר.
ב״חשופה״ אין פילטרים ואין מסכות.
יש אמת.
גם כשהיא כואבת. גם כשהיא לא נוחה. וגם כשהיא גורמת לנו לשאול את עצמנו שאלות שלא תמיד רצינו לשאול.
אני יהודית גאולייב, מנטורית לזוגיות ומחברת הספר ״חשופה״, ובכל פרק אני נכנסת יחד איתכם למקומות הכי רגישים, מסקרנים ולפעמים גם אסורים של מערכות יחסים.
נדבר על מה נשים באמת רוצות מגברים ומה גברים באמת מחפשים בנשים. למה אנחנו נמשכים דווקא למי שלא נותן לנו את מה שאנחנו צריכים. למה לפעמים דווקא כשמישהו רוצה אותנו — אנחנו מאבדים עניין. מה גורם למשיכה להידלק ומה מכבה אותה. למה אנשים בוגדים. למה אנחנו נשארים בקשרים שכבר מזמן היו צריכים להיגמר. ואיך לעזאזל יודעים שזו באמת אהבה — ולא עוד דפוס בתחפושת.
יהיו כאן נשים. יהיו כאן גברים. יהיו סיפורים אמיתיים, דעות שלא תמיד נסכים עליהן, שאלות שלא תמיד נעים לשאול ותשובות שלא תמיד קל לשמוע.
ובעיקר — נדבר אמת.
כי מתחת לכל המשחקים, החוקים, האסטרטגיות והחיפוש אחרי ״האחד״ או ״האחת״, נמצאת מערכת היחסים שממנה הכול מתחיל:
מערכת היחסים שלנו עם עצמנו.
וכשאנחנו מפסיקים לפחד להסתכל פנימה, אנחנו מתחילים לבחור אחרת גם בחוץ.
חשופה.על אהבה, תשוקה, נשים, גברים וכל מה שקורה ביניהם כשאף אחד לא מסתכל.
בלי פילטרים. בלי מסכות. בלי בולשיט.

description: True Crime Podcast, for mature audiences. Buried, Not Forgotten is about the mysterious deaths of Walter Smith and Peter Hauer, in the summer of 1975. Smith never returned from a bike ride from his summer job at Watoga State Park in Pocahontas County, West Virginia. A large-scale search was initiated that week, and volunteer cavers and West Virginia State Police would eventually discover Walter Smith’s body in a cave, under a pile of rocks, on private property. The property owner, Peter Hauer, was a leading expert on saltpeter mining, an accomplished cave explorer, historian and treasurer of the American Spelean History Association. Hauer went missing that same week, shortly after being interviewed by investigators. Some people believe the story in the police report; Peter killed Walter, then took his own life, but many friends and neighbors refuse to believe that is what really happened. In the course of the project, Buried Not Forgotten uncovered information about the police report, FBI investigation, and first-hand accounts that paint a very different picture from what police believed in 1975. Listen to those closest to the case, in their own words, as the truth gets even stranger than it seems at first.

author: Back Garden Cricket Club
description:
Back garden cricket has its own laws: unwritten, fiercely argued, and unique to every lawn, patio and flowerbed in the land. Nobody has ever written them down. Until now.

Forty years ago, the legendary Whispering Bob Harris and Jon Briggs, the original voice of Siri, played cricket in Bob's back garden. Most of the players turned up for the fun, and for the magnificent teas. Bob took it rather more seriously. He kept every score and worked out everyone's averages, and he still has them.

Finding those scorebooks brought the memories flooding back, along with the gloriously bizarre rules needed to make cricket work in Bob's garden. So Bob and Jon have set out to compile the laws the MCC somehow forgot to catalogue.

With the help of some brilliant professional cricketers, they're going back to where it all began: "one hand, one bounce", "tip and run" and the rest. After all, no first-class cricketer started out at Lord's or the MCG. They started with a watering can for a wicket and a healthy fear of the rule that a six over next door's fence means you're out.

author: Gran Sleep History
description:
Welcome to Gran Sleep History.

I’ve always believed history is best experienced through a great story. This channel is for anyone who wants to explore the past through calm, cinematic, and carefully told history documentaries.

Journey through ancient civilizations, powerful empires, legendary rulers, forgotten kingdoms, great wars, mysterious events, and the people who shaped our world.

Each week, Susanna Fields takes three things your child loves and makes magical stories come alive, letting Sunday evenings drift gently into awesome adventures.

description:

Toni and Tales is a podcast about the things we carry quietly; love that cost too much, healing that took too long, and the complicated beauty of becoming. Hosted by Toni, each episode weaves her experiences with yours, because your story matters here too.
New episodes every Tuesday. Pull up a seat. Be gentle with yourself.
Follow the podcast on Instagram: @toniandtalespodcast 
Subscribe on substack: https://substack.com/@toniandtales

Welcome to BACK PORCH STORIES.
This isn't a fancy studio podcast. It's just me, a mic, a cold drink, and the stories I never told anyone.
Growing up weird, broke, and surrounded by characters you can't invent - I got stories for days. From childhood fails, to crazy neighbors, to nights that went completely sideways.
New episodes every week. One story at a time, straight from the back porch.
Best listened to at night.
For fans of Theo Von, This Past Weekend, and real storytelling comedy.

title: RayCoon
author: Ray
description:
Welcome to Raycoon, the podcast that crushes your dreams of effortless passive income and replaces them with brutally honest, data-backed strategies to actually survive the online hustle. Hosted by Alex and Devon, we dive deep into what it really takes to make money online alongside 1.57 billion other digital workers.


​Every week, we guide you through the chaos of the digital landscape. We cover everything from avoiding algorithm obsolescence and commanding premium rates with AI skills, to navigating the wild, high-conversion world of live social commerce. We also translate boring bureaucratic nightmares,
 ​Whether you're trying to dodge "VIP task" scams on Telegram, figuring out zero-commission freelance platforms, or just trying to remember to pay your voluntary social security, we are your ultimate survival guide to the digital rat race. Put some pants on (or don't), upskill yourself, and tune in!

🔎 Get ready for disturbing stories, unexpected twists, and investigations that will make you question everything you thought you knew.

New episodes featuring stories that might keep you awake at night.

T. Straw, and attorney Alexandrea Sharae, will unpack the legal issues behind the headlines and inside our households, bringing you perspectives from two generations. Welcome to JUST SURRENDER, a rough and ready podcast where I speak with my favourite creative people who shape the world through art. Get set for in-depth and raw discussions about music, film, literature, performance – and all the connections between.


I've done hundreds of interviews as an arts journalist and podcaster - this is a selection of my favourites. I'll also be chatting to artists whose work I love ...


Guests include:


EPISODE 1: Extraordinary musician WARREN ELLIS on family trauma and musical catharsis in the documentary ELLIS PARK.


About me: I'm an author, podcaster, poet, editor and arts journalist based in a small town, Castlemaine, in Australia. My two novels, just_a_girl and the bestselling Almost a Mirror, were critically acclaimed and I've also edited two collections of short stories that responded to songs: Into Your Arms: Nick Cave's Songs Reimagined and Spinning Around: The Kylie Playlist. My book Almost a Mirror was developed into a popular podcast and touring show. I write regularly on the arts for many publications including The Guardian and Saturday Paper, and my first book of poetry, Sweet Avalanche, will be published in 2027.

Welcome to Psalm Uninterrupted. Take a deep breath and release the noise of the day.

title: The Debrief by Power Up Church
author: Power Up Church
description:
The Mission Briefing happens Sunday. The Debrief happens Monday.

Every week, Fleet Commander Brandon Holm delivers the Mission Briefing in the Ready Room — the teaching gathering of Power Up Church, a future-focused, nerd-native church reaching believers, seekers, skeptics, and anyone who never fit the traditional church mold, in more than 25 countries. The next day, hosts Erin Dunn and Patrick Nash open the after-action report: a genuine conversation that unpacks the briefing, chases down its tensions, works through the Scripture at its center, and presses on what the teaching actually means for the crew's faith, character, and mission capacity.

This is not a rerun of the sermon audio. It is the debrief that follows the mission — what challenged us, what held up, and what we're each carrying into the week ahead.

New episodes land Monday 17:00 America/Phoenix (Tuesday 09:00 JST).

Erin Dunn and Patrick Nash are virtual hosts --- AI-assisted personas created by Power Up Church for The Debrief. Every Mission Briefing they review is delivered by Fleet Commander Brandon Holm, a real, ordained minister. The theology on this show comes from Scripture and the teaching ministry of real people; Erin and Patrick are the medium, not the source.

If these after-action reports sharpen your thinking, follow The Debrief by Power Up Church on your podcast app of choice --- Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or your preferred player --- so every new episode lands automatically.

title: 15 Minute Break

Big questions. Unexpected answers. One coffee break. What happens when a curious student gets 15 minutes with a Bocconi professor? In 15 Minute Break, a question becomes the starting point for an open conversation, where students challenge assumptions, bring their own perspectives and explore ideas with professors who study them every day.

From AI and the future of education to inflation, trade wars, innovation, data, sustainability, marketing, democracy and inequality, each episode starts with a simple question and goes deeper, connecting academic research with the issues shaping our everyday lives.

No lectures. No easy answers. Just students and professors exchanging ideas and looking at the world from different perspectives.

Because sometimes, all it takes is one good question to start a great conversation.

Take a break. Stay curious.

15 Minute Break, a Bocconi University original podcast, available on YouTube and all major podcast platforms.

title: Stickier: The Craft of Camp Speaking

Stickier is a podcast about how great camp speakers build presentations that connect, resonate, and stick. Through conversations with experienced speakers and presenters, the show explores how ideas are chosen, sessions are shaped, stories and activities are developed, and goals are defined. 

More than a look at presentation technique, Stickier focuses on the thought, preparation, and intention behind a great session, with practical lessons that can help all of us become more effective presenters, educators, trainers, and communicators.

title: How To Heal
author: Professor Omar Faiz
description:
Introducing HOW TO HEAL — a new podcast about what really helps us recover after surgery.


Hosted by world leading surgeon Professor Omar Faiz, each episode brings together patients and medical experts to share extraordinary stories, honest experiences and practical advice about the real road to recovery.

 

From preparing for surgery to navigating the highs and lows of getting back on your feet, How To Heal shares expert insight, real-life experience and hard-won lessons for anyone who wants to better understand their health.

 

Because surgery is only the start of the story. It’s what happens next that matters most.

title: All Things Cruise

Have a question you want us to answer on the show? Head to Jillonmoney.com and click the "Contact Us" button.

author: Amy Switzer
description: Heart to Wonder is a place for those with a heart to wonder. It’s for those who are willing to slow down; for those who long to notice God's fingerprints, ask deeper questions, and discover the beauty, truth, and goodness of who He is.

author: Mike Michaelson
description:
Everything that mattered in the Orlando Magic week, from memorable plays and player performances to roster moves and upcoming matchups. New episodes arrive Sundays.

title: Notes Form The North
author: Putri Intan
description: Welcome back to Notes From The North—a quiet space where we slow down, unfurl our thoughts, and explore the power of keeping a personal journal.Whether you're holding a warm cup of coffee in the morning or winding down under the evening stars, this podcast is your sanctuary for honest reflections, self-discovery, and the beauty of putting pen to paper.Every week, we flip through real entries, unpack life's messy middle, and find meaning in the little daily moments we often overlook.So, grab your favorite notebook, get comfortable, and let’s dive into today’s entry.

title: Through Trial & Fire
author: Marie Columna
description:
Through Trial & Fire is a first-person account of a story told in headlines, courtrooms, interviews, and by others; but never fully told by me. I’m Marie Columna, and I’m telling it from the beginning, in my own words and from my perspective. Through police bodycam, court recordings, news coverage, documents, evidence, and personal videos, I’ll take you inside what happened, what was lost, and what came next. A story of power, control, betrayal, survival, loss, restoration, and reclaiming my voice. 
New episodes every Wednesday.
Follow me on TikTok @mariecolumna

title: Off the Clock Conversations
author: The Juice The Hot One The Guy
description:
Welcome to Off the Clock; Conversations about all things in  mental health. 


The Juice, The Hot One, and The Guy spend their working hours talking about mental health. This show is what happens when they keep talking after the clock stops. Real, honest conversations about stress, relationships, family, burnout, and everything in between.


Episode one is coming soon, so follow or subscribe so you don't miss it.


Tune in to get the story behind their handles! 


Got a topic or question you want us to tackle? 

Send it to podcast@offtheclockconversations.com, 

Find us on Instagram at @offtheclockconversations.


This podcast is for conversation, not therapy. If you're in crisis, call or text 988.


In the meantime watch this episode that offers a few Expressions of Advice


See you soon, Off the Clock.

title: The Woo-Woo of Work
author: Kevin
description:
What if your birth chart could tell you more about your work than your résumé ever could?


The Woo-Woo of Work is where astrology, spirituality, and professional life come together.


Hosted by Kat Niambi, also known as The Hungry Medium, this podcast helps busy professionals better understand who they are, how they’re wired, and how to bring more of their authentic selves into the work they do.


Each week, Kat explores the parts of your chart that can reveal more about your purpose, strengths, patterns, relationships, and the way you naturally move through your career... from your Sun sign and Venus to Chiron, the North Node, the 10th house, and beyond.


This isn’t about using astrology to predict your next promotion. It’s about using it as a tool for deeper self-awareness, alignment, and a more authentic relationship with success.


If you’ve ever felt like the professional version of you doesn’t quite match the real you, you’re in the right place.


It’s time to put the woo-woo back in work.

title: The Sweeney Unofficial Podcast
author: Shane Whaley
description: The Sweeney Unofficial Podcast is a fan-made deep dive into one of Britain’s greatest television crime dramas.  Each episode revisits The Sweeney in detail — from Regan and Carter, the villains, guest stars and memorable dialogue to the cars, locations, fights, fashions, production stories and everything else that made the series such an enduring classic.  We’ll work our way through every episode of the legendary 1970s show, sharing trivia, behind-the-scenes stories, favourite moments and plenty of spirited debate along the way.  We’ll also be joined by cast members, crew and other guests connected to The Sweeney, bringing you first-hand memories from the people who helped make television history.  Made by fans, for fans — whether you watched The Sweeney when it first aired or you’re discovering it for the first time, this is the place to celebrate Regan, Carter and the world of the Flying Squad.

title: God's Money by DFW Ministries
author: DFW.Ministries
description:
God’s Money is back. After more than 25 years on WAY-FM and Christian FM, Don White brings his unique blend of biblical wisdom and decades of financial expertise to DFW Ministries.
Hosted by Jordan Hardison, these short daily episodes explore money, investing, insurance, estate planning, and financial stewardship from a biblical perspective.
New episodes five days a week. Subscribe and join us for God’s Money.

title: The Conversational Space
author: leoladell
description: The Conversational Space is a podcast for the Australia and New Zealand Association of Psychotherapy (ANZAP). It includes discussions focusing on the theory and practice of psychoanalytic psychotherapy in the Conversation Model and related modalities.

title: Afford Anything | Get Smarter With Money
author: jui
description: 45 million downloads. One question: what does it actually take to build wealth?  Each week, Paula Pant brings in economists, investors, business leaders, authors, and researchers to dig into the five pillars of financial freedom — financial psychology, increasing income, investing, real estate, and entrepreneurship. Deep insights rooted in economics and behavioral finance. First-principles thinking. No surface-level tips.  Follow or Subscribe to hear new episodes every Tuesday and Friday.  Get smarter with money. Build wealth.

title: Fide Ex Gratia
author: noah200679
description: Hello, my name is Noah. I am a Protestant who will begin to delve into, and explore the doctrines of the Catholic and Eastern Orthodox Churches. The title "Fide Ex Gratia" means "faith from grace." This perfecrly describes my journey within this podcast, I am pursuing God by faith which I have received by His grace!

title: Tales from the Master of Creep
author: John Fite
description:
Turn down the lights, lock your doors, and put another nail in the coffin. It’s time for Tales from the Master of Creep—a horror storytelling podcast where nightmares come alive and laughter sometimes escapes at the worst possible moment.

Enter a world of restless ghosts, sinister strangers, haunted places, and ordinary people having extraordinarily bad nights. These original scary stories combine creeping suspense, unexpected twists, and wicked humor. You might laugh at someone’s terrible decision—until you hear the same strange noise outside your own bedroom.

Subscribe, settle in, and sleep with one eye open. And remember… never listen alone.

title: The Revenue growth lab Podcast
author: nhyu
description: The Revenue Growth Lab Podcast is your practical guide to revenue growth, sales, marketing, customer acquisition, and business growth. Each episode explores proven strategies, real-world insights, and actionable ideas to help entrepreneurs, founders, business owners, sales professionals, and marketers build more profitable and sustainable businesses.  We dive deep into revenue growth strategies, B2B sales, lead generation, customer acquisition, digital marketing, sales funnels, conversion optimization, pricing, retention, business strategy, and scaling. You'll hear practical lessons, expert conversations, growth experiments, and actionable frameworks designed to help you attract more customers, increase sales, improve profitability, and create predictable revenue.  Whether you're launching a startup, growing a small business, leading a sales team, or scaling an established company, The Revenue Growth Lab gives you actionable insights you can apply immediately.  Topics include:  Revenue Growth & Business Growth  Sales Strategy & B2B Sales  Lead Generation & Customer Acquisition  Digital Marketing & Growth Marketing  Sales Funnels & Conversion Optimization  Pricing & Profitability  Customer Retention & Lifetime Value  Entrepreneurship & Startups  Scaling & Sustainable Growth  AI, Technology & Modern Growth Strategies  Subscribe to The Revenue Growth Lab Podcast for conversations, strategies, and practical growth lessons that turn ideas into measurable business results.

title: The Why Files: Operation Podcast
author: bgty
description: The Why Files covers mysteries, myths and legends. We tell stories and seek the truth in a fun and lighthearted way. Our content is heavily researched; we don't release an episode unless we're sure we can bring something new to a topic.

title: Miixed: Conversations About Chronic Illness and Relationships
author: Kodi
description: Miixed explores mixed-ability relationships, chronic illness, intimacy, identity shift, and partnership. Hosted by An Issue with Kodi, Kodi invites couples and professionals to have conversations that are both relatable and resourceful for those seeking a community of others in mixed-ability relationships. Click follow to receive updates as each new episode is shared.

title: The WTM Conversations
author: WTM Media
description:
The WTM Conversations explores the people, ideas and systems shaping our world—and what they mean for the future we are creating together.
Hosted by Kelly Dowd, MBA, MA, Editor-in-Chief of WTM Media, each long-form conversation moves beyond headlines and soundbites to examine leadership, culture, technology, design, business, geopolitics, science, sustainability, identity and human potential.
Through conversations with thinkers, builders, leaders, artists and innovators, we ask a deceptively simple question: Why do these things matter?
Ideas. Leadership. Perspectives that last.
A WTM Media original.

title: The Telepathy Tapes
author: vfgt
description: The Telepathy Tapes is a podcast that explores the origins of consciousness and the unexplained abilities of ESP through science, verifiable experience, formal testing, and human story. In Season One, non-speaking individuals with autism reveal striking telepathic abilities that challenge everything we thought we knew about the mind. In Season Two- The Consciousness Cassettes, the lens widens to extraordinary experiences that invite us to rethink reality itself. From near death experiences to telepathic communication with animals, energy healing to plant intelligence, and the origins of creativity to sudden savant abilities - each episode offers a rare glimpse into the vast terrain of consciousness beyond the brain.

title: Cultures Behind Careers

description:
Cultures Behind Careers looks beyond job titles and diversity statistics to explore the cultures, identities, expectations and experiences that shape our working lives.
We’ll talk about what organisations get wrong about culture and inclusion and what it takes to get it right.
Because careers aren’t just about what we do. They’re shaped by who we are, what shaped us, the environments we work in and what those environments make possible.
What’s the culture behind your career?
